request.style: English, male tenor solo with Celtic choir, bodhran, uilleann pipes, fiddle, acoustic guitar, harp, majestic and hopeful, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Have I been with you all this time
And you still do not know me
Whoever has seen me has seen the Father
How can you ask to see Him
Do you not believe I am in the Father
And the Father is in me
The words I speak are not my own
The Father living in me does His works

[Chorus]
I tell you the truth
Whoever believes in me
Will do the works I am doing
And will do even greater things
Because I am going to the Father

[Verse]
Whatever you ask in my name
I will do it for the Father
So that He may be glorified in the Son
If you ask me anything in my name
I will do it
If you love me you will keep my commandments

[Chorus]
I tell you the truth
Whoever believes in me
Will do the works I am doing
And will do even greater things
Because I am going to the Father

[Bridge]
Believe me when I say I am in the Father
And the Father is in me
Or believe on account of the works themselves

[Chorus]
I tell you the truth
Whoever believes in me
Will do the works I am doing
And will do even greater things
Because I am going to the Father
